snippet.title: Imagine Sisyphus Happy - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮Wishlist Imagine Sisyphus Happy on Steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3959020/Imagine_Sisyphus_Happy/

UPD: Thanks for all the hype! 🎉 We’re moving the demo release up — it’s coming October 2!
⚡💬Join our Discord! https://discord.gg/Fhvk6pu3Bb

🎥 Sisyphus didn't give up – he decided to livestream it!

🪨Imagine Sisyphus Happy is a unique Clicker + QTE game about life, spectacle, and making the grind worth living. Push the boulder. Do tricks. Go live. 
- Aren’t you a Sisyphus too? 
- Can you Imagine Sisyphus Happy?
